title: 第17章 不要她去赶圩
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 早上徐喜弟是硬撑着起来的。她还得盯着巴儿姐。范金花看到早起的徐喜弟，心里很诧异。前几天觉得她十分娇气，使力的又不是她，天天睡到日上三竿。可是昨夜扒了墙缝，才知道这小丫头片子，骨子里是真骚气。难怪夜夜折腾到深夜，她就没少下功夫，所以才起不来床。今天起这么早，是适应了？徐喜弟不知道婆婆心中的波涛暗涌，出了房门就找巴儿姐。在家里转了一圈，最后总算看到巴儿姐揉着眼从屋里出来。两人去后院洗漱。徐喜弟刚拿出牙刷挤上牙膏，就见巴儿姐拿着葫芦瓢，咕嘟嘟漱了一口。然后往手里倒水，两边眼角点了点，就把水瓢往旁边一丢。这就洗完了？徐喜弟也没功夫怔愣，连忙刷牙。刚刷一口泡沫，就见刘宇宁从岔路口朝他们家走来。“喜弟，今天起这么早？”他似乎有些诧异。“鞥～”徐喜弟模糊应了一声，继续快速捅牙。起晚让他撞见，起早了又让他撞见。刘宇宁只是笑了一声，然后从前门进院。等她刷牙洗脸进屋，看到范金花正用抹布擦背篓。刘宇宁就站在一边。“宇宁哥，来借背篓？”徐喜弟上前打招呼。刘宇宁朝她笑了笑，“我今天不用干活，带永福去镇上看看医师。”呃～看医生？“病了？”她往张永福的屋里看了一眼。她才几天没伺候他吃喝拉撒，就生病了？难道张国海真的给他刨了木塞子？“我看他精神不太好，今天圩日，带去看看。”刘宇宁接过擦好的背篓，在身后试了试。“紧了点，但不妨碍使用。”说完，就背着进了张永福的屋。没多久，又出来，背篓里坐着张永福。“阿巴，阿巴巴……”巴儿姐手里拿着一根柴火，从火房里出来。应该是听见了动静，看到刘宇宁背着张永福，就知道要去镇上了。她把手里的木柴往旁边一丢，就跟了上来。可刘宇宁背着人，不敢独自带她去镇上，怕人多走丢，于是看看徐喜弟。“喜弟，今天圩日，一起去镇上玩玩吗？”徐喜弟刚想说不去，张永福就不客气地嚷嚷起来。“不要她去！不要这个贱人去赶圩！”徐喜弟：……范金花：……刘宇宁：……“嫂，你家那把崩断的刨锄呢？今天圩日，我一块给拿去修一修。”进门的刘烨，打破了堂屋里的尴尬。他手里同样拿着一把断了一小节的钉锄。范金花才从门背把刨锄拿出来，张永福又开始嚷嚷。“不用你拿去修！哥，我们去修，不用他！”“唉，你个小兔崽子，怎么跟你哥说话的？！”刘烨上去就给张永福的脑门，嘣地弹了一下。“你个老流氓，滚出我家！”张永福捂着脑袋，脱口就骂。刘烨一听，抬起手，“还喷粪，信不信我抽你这张臭嘴巴！”刘宇宁连忙背着人，快一步出了家门，“哥，我带永福去镇上医院看看，先走一步。”徐喜弟没想到傻叔会这个时候来，想到他昨夜一股蛮劲折腾到深夜，她老脸就发烫。想进屋去躲躲，巴儿姐已经蹿出去了。“唉~”她只能撵着巴儿姐往外追。范金花直皱眉头。“婶，你放心，我看着她们。”刘烨扛着两把崩坏的农具，往门口看了一眼。“我给你拿几块钱，巴儿姐到了镇上指定要吃碗粉的，她们早饭都没吃。”范金花转身想进屋找钱。“不用不用，我这里有。”刘烨憨憨地摆摆手，怕范金花不信，从裤兜里掏出来一卷钱。“你哪儿来的钱？”这傻大个身上能掏出钱来，也是真稀罕，范金花诧异地看着他手里的钱，估计得十几块吧。“宇宁给的，够用。我去了啊。”刘烨把钱塞回兜里，扛着农具也快步离开。……巴儿姐脚步飞快，没一会儿，就追上了刘宇宁。“阿巴，阿巴……”张永福看到巴儿姐，回头往村里看，正好，徐喜弟小跑往这边追，后边刘烨三五步就给撵上她了。被撵上的徐喜弟，竟不跑了，放慢了脚步，两人一前一后，有说有笑。张永福拍拍刘宇宁的肩头，“哥，哥，别走那么快，等等他们！”“我倒要看看，他们有什么可说的，没完没了！”“这个老流氓！不能让他们单独走一块！”刘宇宁一听，回头看了一眼，“烨哥这几年，也没少帮衬你家地里的活，为什么骂他老流氓？”他不懂，为什么张永福对刘烨的，态度这么差，张口就骂老流氓。“我不能说。”张永福嗤鼻，“他这些年帮衬的，也不止我们家，而且他也不是白帮忙。”“你猜，他为什么一把年纪了还不着急娶妻？”“还不是因为穷？家里就剩他一个人，又没父母帮衬。”刘宇宁回道。“不，他是在等我死！想捡便宜！呸！我就偏要长命百岁！熬死他！”张永福往背后啐了一口。“等你死……你说他盯着喜弟？”刘宇宁笑了，心里也跟着乐，这不等于癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅屁吗？就算张永福真死了，也轮不到刘烨这傻大个。“哼~说了你还不信，他根本就是冲着那个贱女人来的。”再次听到张永福骂徐喜弟，刘宇宁停下了脚步，转回头，表情也变得严肃起来。“弟，喜弟对张家尽心尽力，全村人都看在眼里。你摸摸良心，她哪里对不起你？”“十几年如一日，她一句怨言都没有，你这样骂她，不对。”“还有烨哥，你也误会他了。从前他没有父母帮衬，现在兄弟我熬出头了，我来帮衬他。”“我已经让他找媒人说亲，彩礼钱多少我来掏，他很快就会有自己的媳妇。”“你应该担心的是，等他有了自己的媳妇，要顾自己的家，你们家地里的重活，还能指望谁帮衬。”“你掏彩礼给他娶媳妇？凭什么？”张永福只抓住了这个重点，在背篓里差点就蹦出来。“凭他和我一样姓刘，凭他帮衬了你家好几年，也凭他从小就带着我俩玩。”刘宇宁叹了一口气，郑重说道。“那……也不能让他俩单独走！”张永福嘟囔了一句。
content_en: In the morning, Xu Xidi managed to get up.She still had to keep an eye on Sister Baer.Fan Jinhua was surprised when she saw Xu Xidi getting up early.A few days ago, I felt that she was very squeamish, and she was not the one who exerted all her strength. She slept until midnight every day.But last night when I dug through the cracks in the wall, I realized that this little girl is really naughty at heart.No wonder she worked hard every night until late at night, so she couldn't get out of bed.Did you get used to getting up so early today?Xu Xidi didn't know what was going on in his mother-in-law's heart, so he looked for Sister Ba'er after leaving the room.After walking around the house, I finally saw Sister Ba'er coming out of the house, rubbing her eyes.The two went to the backyard to wash up.As soon as Xu Xidi took out his toothbrush and put on toothpaste, he saw Sister Ba'er holding a gourd gourd and gargling a mouthful.Then he poured water into his hand, tapped the corners of his eyes, and threw the water ladle aside.Is this done?Xu Xidi didn't have time to be stunned and quickly brushed his teeth.As soon as he took a sip of foam, he saw Liu Yuning walking towards their house from the fork in the road."Brother happy, did you get up so early today?" He seemed a little surprised."鞥~" Xu Xidi responded vaguely and continued to poke his teeth rapidly.If you wake up late, let him bump into you. If you wake up early, let him bump into you again.Liu Yuning just laughed and entered the hospital through the front door.After she brushed her teeth and washed her face, she entered the room and saw Fan Jinhua wiping the backpack with a rag.Liu Yuning stood aside."Brother Yuning, come to borrow a backpack?" Xu Xidi stepped forward to say hello.Liu Yuning smiled at her, "I don't have to work today. I'm taking Yongfu to the town to see a doctor." Uh~ see a doctor?"Sick?" She glanced into Zhang Yongfu's room.It had only been a few days since she had served him, and she was already sick?Did Zhang Guohai really dig out the cork for him?"I think he's not in good spirits. Let's take him to have a look today." Liu Yuning took the wiped backpack and tried it behind him."It's a little tight, but it doesn't hinder its use." After saying that, he carried it into Zhang Yongfu's house.Not long after, he came out again and found Zhang Yongfu sitting in a basket on his back."Aba, Aba..." Sister Ba'er came out of the fire room with a piece of firewood in her hand.He must have heard the noise and saw Liu Yuning carrying Zhang Yongfu on his back, so he knew he was going to town.She threw the firewood aside and followed.But Liu Yuning was carrying someone on his back and did not dare to take her to the town alone. He was afraid of getting lost in the crowd, so he looked at Xu Xidi."Xidi, today is the day of the fair, do you want to go to the town to play together?" Xu Xidi was about to say no, but Zhang Yongfu shouted rudely."Don't want her to go! Don't want this bitch to go to the polder!" Xu Xidi:...Fan Jinhua:...Liu Yuning:..."Sister-in-law, where is your broken hoe? Today is the polder day, I will take it and repair it together." Liu Ye came in, breaking the embarrassment in the hall.He also held a hoe with a broken section in his hand.Fan Jinhua took out the planing hoe from the back of the door, and Zhang Yongfu started shouting again."You don't have to use it to repair it! Brother, let's go and repair it without him!" "Oh, you little brat, why are you talking to your brother?!" Liu Ye went up and flicked Zhang Yongfu's forehead."You old gangster, get out of my house!" Zhang Yongfu covered his head and cursed.When Liu Ye heard this, he raised his hand and said, "You're spitting feces, believe it or not, I'm going to slap your stinky mouth!" Liu Yuning quickly carried people on his back and walked out of the house quickly, "Brother, I'll take Yongfu to the hospital in town to check it out. Let's go first." Xu Xidi didn't expect that the stupid uncle would come at this time. Thinking of his brute strength last night, her old face felt hot.I wanted to go into the house and hide, but Sister Baer had already jumped out."Alas~" She could only chase Sister Ba'er outside.Fan Jinhua frowned."Aunt, don't worry, I'm watching them." Liu Ye carried two broken farm tools and glanced at the door."I'll give you a few dollars. Sister Ba'er came to town and asked for a bowl of noodles. They didn't even eat breakfast." Fan Jinhua turned around and wanted to go into the house to find money."No, no, no, I have it here." Liu Ye waved his hand naively, fearing that Fan Jinhua wouldn't believe it, so he took out a roll of money from his trouser pocket."Where did you get the money?" It was really rare for this stupid big man to have money on his body. Fan Jinhua looked at the money in his hand in surprise. It was estimated to be more than ten yuan."Yuning gave it, it's enough. I'm going." Liu Ye put the money back into his pocket, carried the farm tools and left quickly....Sister Baer's steps were fast, and she caught up with Liu Yuning in a short while."Aba, Aba..." Zhang Yongfu saw Sister Ba'er and turned back to look into the village. Just then, Xu Xidi ran over to chase her, and Liu Ye caught up with her in a few steps.Xu Xidi, who was kicked out, actually stopped running and slowed down his pace. The two of them walked one behind the other, talking and laughing.Zhang Yongfu patted Liu Yuning on the shoulder, "Brother, brother, don't walk so fast, wait for them!" "I want to see what they have to say, there is no end!" "This old gangster! We can't let them walk alone!"When Liu Yuning heard this, he looked back and said, "Brother Ye has been helping you with the farm work in the past few years. Why do you call him an old gangster?" He didn't understand why Zhang Yongfu had such a bad attitude towards Liu Ye and called him an old gangster."I can't say." Zhang Yongfu snorted, "He has helped more than just our family over the years, and his help is not in vain." "Guess, why is he not in a hurry to get a wife even at his age?" "Isn't it because he is poor? He is the only one in the family, and he has no parents to help him," Liu Yuning replied."No, he is waiting for me to die! He wants to take advantage! Bah! I just want to live a long life! I'll kill him!" Zhang Yongfu spat behind him."Waiting for you to die...you said he was staring at Xidi?" Liu Yuning smiled, and he was also happy in his heart. Doesn't this mean that the toad wants to eat the swan's fart?Even if Zhang Yongfu really dies, it won't be Liu Ye's turn."Huh~ If you still don't believe me, he is here for that bitch." Hearing Zhang Yongfu scolding Xu Xidi again, Liu Yuning stopped, turned around, and his expression became serious."Brother, Brother Xi has done his best for the Zhang family, and the whole village has seen it. If you have a good conscience, how can she feel sorry for you?" "For more than ten years, she has not complained a word, and it is wrong for you to scold her like this." "And Brother Ye, you also misunderstood him. In the past, he had no parents to help him, but now that I have made it through, brother, I will help him." "I have asked him to.Find a matchmaker and I'll pay for the bride price. He will have his own wife soon."What you should worry about is that when he has his own wife, who can you expect to help him with the heavy work in the field?""Why should you pay the bride price for him?"Zhang Yongfu only grasped this point and almost jumped out of his bag."Because his surname is Liu like mine, because he has been taking care of your family for several years, and because he has played with us since we were young." Liu Yuning sighed and said solemnly."Then... we can't let them go alone!" Zhang Yongfu muttered.
